# growthbook_saved_group (Resource)

Manages a GrowthBook saved group, a reusable list of attribute values or a condition that feature rules can target.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "growthbook_saved_group" "beta_users" {
  name          = "Beta Users"
  type          = "list"
  attribute_key = "userId"
  values        = ["user-123", "user-456"]
}

resource "growthbook_saved_group" "us_visitors" {
  name      = "US Visitors"
  type      = "condition"
  condition = jsonencode({ country = "US" })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the saved group.
- `type` (String) Saved group type: `condition` (targets by a JSON condition) or `list` (targets by a list of values for one attribute). Immutable after creation.

### Optional

- `attribute_key` (String) Attribute key the group's list of values is based on. Required when `type = "list"`, and rejected when `type = "condition"`. Immutable after creation.
- `condition` (String) JSON-encoded condition for the group. Required when `type = "condition"`, and rejected when `type = "list"`.
- `owner` (String) The userId or email address of the owner. Defaults to the user associated with the request's Personal Access Token when omitted.
- `projects` (Set of String) Project ids this saved group is scoped to. Omit to leave unchanged; set to `[]` to clear (all projects).
- `values` (Set of String) List of attribute values for `type = "list"`. Omit to leave unchanged; set to `[]` to clear.

### Read-Only

- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the saved group is archived. Not settable through this resource.
- `date_created` (String) RFC3339 timestamp the saved group was created.
- `date_updated` (String) RFC3339 timestamp the saved group was last updated.
- `description` (String) Description of the saved group. Not settable through this API; GrowthBook does not accept it on create or update.
- `id` (String) GrowthBook saved group id.
- `owner_email` (String) Email address of the owner, when it can be resolved to a known user.
- `use_empty_list_group` (Boolean) GrowthBook-managed flag for empty list-group handling.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import growthbook_saved_group.beta_users sg_abc123
```
